title: Smoky Breakfast Skillet
description: A hearty and energizing breakfast skillet filled with smoky flavors and crunchy texture. Perfect for a weekend brunch.

ingredients.name: Smoky Bacon
ingredients.notes: Look for thick-cut bacon for a smokier flavor

ingredients.name: Chopped Bell Peppers
ingredients.notes: Any color bell pepper works well

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onion for even cooking

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic for added flavor

ingredients.name: Shredded Cheese
ingredients.notes: Cheddar or Monterey Jack work well

ingredients.name: Fresh Cilantro
ingredients.notes: Chopped cilantro adds a bright freshness

instructions: 1. Heat a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the bacon and cook until crispy. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
3. Add the chopped bell peppers and onion to the skillet. Cook until they start to soften.
4. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
5. Push the vegetables to one side of the skillet. Crack in the eggs and scramble them until cooked through.
6. Mix the eggs with the vegetables.
7. Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top of the skillet.
8. Return the cooked bacon to the skillet and stir to combine.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
